verdict.rationale: Zoho Books explicitly documents API parity as a design goal ('perform all the operations that you do with our web client'), backs it with a comprehensive REST API covering contacts, banking/reconciliation, org settings, 1099 tracking, and publishes a full OpenAPI spec plus OAuth scopes catalog. missing for 10: independent third-party verification of full parity claim, and evidence is vendor-documented only (no hands-on audit confirming every UI feature has an API equivalent).
